# PALSEC AGCY

> Strategic design studio based in Costa Brava, Spain. We work across brand strategy, branding, web design, motion graphics, and creative direction — from definition to execution.

## Services

- Brand strategy
- Branding & visual identity
- Web design & digital product (UX/UI)
- Motion graphics
- Creative direction
- Print graphics & spatial materials

## Projects

### VIRA (2026)
Client: PALSEC
App designed to help address the main challenges faced by teenagers with ADHD. UX/UI mobile, brand identity, visual system, and design language.

### ARKUOS (2026)
Client: PALSEC
Socio-educational action space and creative environment for children, teenagers, and young people. Brand application, design system, communication pieces, and visual language.

### GALEÓN (2026)
Client: PALSEC
Interactive application that allows users to travel through the history of the Spanish monarchy via the Royal Collections. Product design, UX/UI, visual system, and interactive content.

### EL XIRINGUITO (2026)
Client: PALSEC
Complete brand identity for a coastal restaurant designed to convey a light, bright Mediterranean aesthetic. Brand identity, menu system, print & signage, and digital assets.

### ENTEZA (2026)
Client: PALSEC
Brand focused on furniture and tableware rentals for events, with an emphasis on design, elegance, and quality. Brand system, catalog structure, digital design, and product presentation.

### GENT GRAN DE CALONGE I SANT ANTONI (2026)
Client: PALSEC
Project developed for a municipal social services department to give visibility and cohesion to activities for older adults. Public sector brand identity, communication system, print & digital.

### LOGOTECA (2026)
Client: PALSEC
Curated collection of logo design work. Brand identity explorations.

### BON DIA VEÏNAT / PALSEC AI LAB (2026)
Client: AJUNTAMENT DE BARCELONA
Civic project for the Ajuntament de Barcelona designed to improve cooperation between neighbors. Service design, UX/UI, accessibility.

### ESTUDI DENTAL CARRERA (2026)
Client: PALSEC
Brand identity and visual system for a dental practice.
